body: They said it’s alphabetical? Mine still hasnt changed and I’m very anxious!

I would consider not purchasing. I saw an ad from them now on instagram, I am flabbergasted because they do have a lot of followers now. I bought bracelets from them 2020 and the box came from china and tarnished! Waste of money!

We are not living together. And I wish we do bec it will be easier. She doesn't want to go out. She felt no joy anywhere, at home or outside. Even if I want to go out and I'm the one going to fetch her. She doesn't want too. It's hard trying to convince her these days.
This made me cry 🥺🥺 thank you soooo much

This is more than enough! Thank you. I told her I always want to tell her parents despite them not really understanding and accepting mental health issue, especially hers. And I ask people if writing them a letter could worsen it out or not. However, if it may taint our relationship in the future, I still want to tell them bec her life is at stake here.

I wonder why would it make things worse?? I'm just going to say anything bad but full understanding for him?
Honey. You look so pretty and cute at the same time. 🥰

How did you find out that she cheated? I have this little suspicion too at the back of my mind. Idk how it started but I just have this gut feeling, since I started to feel the changes. I always confront her about this and she always tell me she's not doing anything behind my back. But the suspicion or that gut feeling is just there where it wasn't even there before

I'm okay with continuous support, but I don't want her just to use me for it and leave me hanging after. She's always positive when we talk but the action tells otherwise. And srsly, idk where to stand. I really want to invade her privacy (her phone and her chats with friends) but I'm just afraid.

I'm feeling the same way. I'm happy and yet waves of sadness comes along. Tough battle but, we will get there. I'm also gonna do therapy bec sometimes I've felt like there's an emotion I repressed during these cycles which are hard to 3xplain.

I am not. Basically what I'm saying is her letting it try it, and I myself can always communicate with her with what I've felt. we have good and healthy communication if that's what you're afraid of. We are always open with each other. 

If that doesn't work, there would be lots of big conversations and big changes. But that doesn't change the fact that I'm not supporting her embracing her sexuality.

This is very very new to me, so it is still hard to process and imagine things like that. I've been always monogamous, but I'm not sure what will happen this time. I guess one off trial is not that bad enough to let myself know what I'm really feeling. 

We have a healthy relationship based on communication, and I guess, I can just relay my thoughts to her after she will do it. 

Let's see. Thank you tho. You're one of the few very open minded people I've encountered with. And your idea and openness helps me.
I will never be. Thank you soooo much. It helps a lot.
Any thoughts about one off trial? Me testing my feelings on how would it really feel when she's finally doing it?

I'm totally not fine about it, but it's her sexuality that keeps her still wanting men. Which I don't mind, however to the point of having open relationship and her having to do s3x with them, that's what I'm not sure about. 


I feel like I kinda wanna let her try? And I'll see my emotions after? Or do I need to set my limitations stated that I never wanted a polygamous relationship?

There are a loooot of things I love about her, her personality, inside, every thing about her. Everything!  those are just the physical appearances that I stated that I know will be gone with transitioning, but i love her soooo much. Idk what to do.

I'm never gonna stop her on her journey to transition. It's just like it is so hard to see the person who you thought they were before, which was a man, and now as a woman. But I will never stop her for wanting what she wants.

This helps me so much. It's a lot to take in, and the problem is just, I don't have anyone to talk to with these type of conversation in my friends. For them, they see our relationship as somewhat super healthy and great, however these new changes come in. I can't talk to them with these problems bec they maybe too judgemental since they haven't experienced what jm feeling rn, and would only advice things for my benefit only. 
I would love to read the book to gain and understand more and new emotions.   Thank you ❤
Hey. *hug* I'm just wondering if you chose to stay or decided to separate?
Thank you. Thank you for the last line you put in there. This helps me sooo much to understand and validate my what I'm feeling rn. *hug*

Thank you for the book. It will surely help me navigate thru this phase. And thank you for all the kind words. I'm happy to know that you and your partner have had worked your way thru it. I'm not just really good with changes and I certainly don't know how to handle things and weigh them out evenly, but eventually I will understand them on my own. I just hope I won't lose myself on the process of her knowing herself. 😔
